lane:
ميب

ميبة مَيْبَةٌ _A certain remedy,_ or _medicine:_ (K:) [an arabicized word] from the Persian مَىْ “ a beverage, ” and بِهْ “ a quince: ” _quince-beverage; diacydonium; a medicine prepared of the juice of quinces:_ some of it is raw; and some, not raw: some is perfumed; and some, not perfumed. (TA, from the book entitled Má lá yesa'u, &c.)

entries.text: ميب: المَيْبَةُ: شيءٌ مِنَ الأَدوية، فارسيٌّ.
